budget.note: No vendor model was called. The only model peer is a loopback OpenAI-compatible mock created by the E2 case.

stages.title: Fail-closed independent harness and checkpoint
notes: Wave-04 hardened gate: 21 original rejections plus 29 independent mutation cases (wrong layer, dirty/missing/cross-commit source, unbound case, empty evidence, missing case, failed assertion, download bytes/digest, patch apply/digest, duplicate/unknown ids, native executed/version/attempt/evidence/model-tasks, installation staged/independence, NOT_TESTED, self-claim, exact reproduced admission probe, tier superset, no allow-gap).
full-product is now a strict superset of every lower tier; full runs fail on missing install/native evidence instead of passing on controlled cases.

stages.title: Daily product vertical and negative cases
notes: Real SQLite, real scratch subprocess and real verification through authenticated loopback HTTP.

Covers question/answer/delivery, machine PASS and FAIL, patch apply to the recorded base commit, artifact byte roundtrip, command replay/conflict, stale contract/candidate/answer, two-conversation isolation, stop/continue writer identity, scope/profile guards, restart persistence and a loopback SDK mock chat.

stages.title: Independent browser, visual geometry and interaction regression
notes: Packaged workbench at 1440x900, 1280x800 and 390x844; geometry/overflow/reachability rather than aesthetic scoring.
Covers the decision inbox, patch preview, byte-verified artifact download, UI acceptance, reopen, loading, error, SSE-offline, tab focus, long Chinese/path and list scrolling.

stages.title: Bounded stability and portability boundaries
notes: Mixed question/complete/fail/stop cycles with a restart in the middle; process/FD/RSS/disk/receipt observations remain scoped to this instance.
Attempt identities, begin ACKs and dispatch facts are read read-only from runtime_bindings, dispatch_receipts and runtime_observations; a schema change yields UNKNOWN instead of a pass.
Portable installation, first-run, backup/restore and upgrade rollback are declared NOT_TESTED because D's directories are absent in this checkout.

stages.title: Release matrix, re-verification and handoff
notes: Aggregates the recorded cases into a reproducible matrix bound to the source commit.
A full-product claim is rejected by the gate while native and installation evidence are absent.
